control.controlName: Ensure storage accounts disallow public blob access
control.manualRemediation: On each storage account set Allow Blob public access to Disabled (Configuration blade).
control.rationale: Public blob access can leak container data to anonymous callers.

control.controlName: Ensure NSGs restrict RDP from the internet
control.manualRemediation: In the NSG, remove or restrict the inbound rule allowing the internet to 3389; use Azure Bastion or a VPN instead.
control.cliRemediation: az network nsg rule update --nsg-name <nsg> --resource-group <rg> --name <rule> --access Deny --destination-port-ranges 3389
control.buildTimeRemediation:
security_rule {
  name = "deny-rdp"
  priority = 100
  direction = "Inbound"
  access = "Deny"
  protocol = "Tcp"
  destination_port_range = "3389"
  source_address_prefix = "Internet"
}
control.rationale: RDP (3389) open to the internet is a top ransomware entry vector.

control.controlName: Ensure SQL servers have auditing enabled
control.manualRemediation: Enable SQL Server auditing and send logs to a Log Analytics workspace or storage account.
control.cliRemediation: az sql server audit-policy update --resource-group <rg> --name <server> --state Enabled --storage-account <sa>
control.rationale: Auditing provides the record needed to detect and investigate database activity.
